title: 参考 · 杏仁核 — 神经科学

questions.question: 这篇参考条目认为，比「恐惧中枢」更准确的杏仁核画像是什么？
options: 一个负面情绪的总开关，只在面对威胁和危险时才被激活
显著性探测器：估一件事跟我关系多大、多不确定，好坏都会点亮
恐惧中枢：它一旦受损，这个人从此就再也不能感到恐惧了
一个理性核实中心，负责细看信号并判断威胁是否真实
questions.explanation: 文章指出杏仁核在惊讶、好奇、兴奋、看到暧昧表情甚至碰到好事时都会活跃，而受损者也并非从此不知恐惧，所以更像「重要性」探测器，正负通吃。慢慢细看、核实威胁的是绕道皮层的「高路」，不是杏仁核本身。
questions.question_en: According to this reference entry, what is a more accurate picture of the amygdala than "the fear center"?
options_en: A master switch for negative emotion, activated only by threats and danger
A salience detector gauging how much something matters to me and how uncertain it is, lit up by good things as well as bad
A fear center: once it's damaged, the person can never feel fear again
A rational verification center that examines signals and decides whether a threat is real
questions.explanation_en: The entry notes the amygdala is active during surprise, curiosity, excitement, ambiguous faces and even good news, and that people with amygdala damage don't simply lose fear — so it's better seen as a relevance detector for both positive and negative. Careful checking of threats is the cortical "high road," not the amygdala itself.

questions.question: 放进「情绪建构」框架里看，杏仁核在一次情绪的产生中扮演什么角色？
options: 发出「这事重要且不确定」的信号、抬高唤醒度，成为什么情绪取决于情境
只在负面情境下参与，正面情绪完全由其他脑区独立产生
先判定这是哪一种情绪，再把结果交给下丘脑去执行身体反应
直接生成恐惧这一成品情绪，皮层只是在事后给这个已经成形的情绪贴上名称
questions.explanation: 文章说杏仁核提供的不是「恐惧」这个成品，而是一记加急信号：抬高核心情感的唤醒度、给身体预算按下动员键；被抬高的身体状态最终被建构成恐惧、愤怒还是兴奋，是全脑合作的结果，不是杏仁核一个人说了算。
questions.question_en: Viewed through the theory of constructed emotion, what role does the amygdala play in producing an emotion?
options_en: It sends an urgent "this matters and is uncertain" signal and raises arousal; whether that becomes fear or excitement depends on concepts and context
It joins in only in negative situations; positive emotions are produced entirely by other regions
It first decides which emotion this is, then hands the result to the hypothalamus to carry out
It directly produces the finished emotion of fear, which the cortex merely labels after it has formed
questions.explanation_en: The entry says the amygdala supplies not a finished "fear" but an urgent signal: raising core-affect arousal and mobilizing the body budget. Whether that heightened state is constructed as fear, anger or excitement is a whole-brain outcome, not the amygdala's call alone.
